features: Multi-directional dome with four individually adjustable 5MP camera heads (20MP total) for up to 360-degree panoramic coverage on one IP address
motorized F1.6 lenses (2.8-8 mm), remote focus + zoom, 10x digital zoom, Gen3 HDR engine, removable IR-cut filter
8-zone multizone IR illumination effective up to 20 m, flexible per-head positioning (pan +-90, tilt 0 to +95, twist +-20)
smart analytics: face detection, intrusion, line crossing, line counting, occupancy, loitering, wrong way, crowd, object left behind/removed, motion heat map, dwell time
two-way audio (G.711/G.726/AAC/LPCM, built-in mic + line in/out), micro SD and M.2 SATA3 SSD storage, NAS recording, Verint EdgeVR platform

frigate.notes: Verint ONVIF camera (EdgeVR platform) — RTSP path not published; use go2rtc ONVIF autodiscovery (onvif://{user}:{pass}@{ip}) to resolve the stream URL.

blue_iris.notes: Use Generic ONVIF/RTSP; discover the stream path.
